name: blender_mcp
summary: Outbound connector mirroring the third_party/discord+pinterest pattern but pointing at a Blender MCP server. When the MCP server is reachable (stdio JSON-RPC), proxies tool calls like mesh.create / material.set / light.add / render.image. Falls back to `blender --background --python-expr <code>` subprocess when MCP unreachable. Lets Claude / the chain DRIVE Blender's bpy API directly — closes the 3D modeling loop.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass. JSON-RPC over stdio by default; HTTP endpoint when configured. Last-resort bpy fallback via subprocess. Same crystal-id stamping + send-log pattern as Discord/Telegram/etc.
closes_the_3d_loop: Pinterest harvest → SVG geometry → spatial_anchor room mesh → blender_mcp.create_primitive + material.set + light.add + render.image → workflow_generator --target blender. Claude can model 3D scenes from natural language. The render output crystal-anchors back into the chain.
guarantees: Graceful degradation — when blender-mcp not installed, fallback to raw `blender --python-expr`
Same connector shape as Discord/Pinterest/etc. — uniform third_party pattern
Every tool invocation logged via send_log → searchable
Tool call args + result JSON-serializable → crystal-chain compatible
usage_example:
from third_party.base import ConnectionConfig
from third_party.blender_mcp import BlenderMCPConnector
c = BlenderMCPConnector(ConnectionConfig(service='blender_mcp'))
c.connect()
c.create_primitive('cube', 2.0, name='Box')
c.set_material_rgb('Box', [1.0, 0.5, 0.1])
c.add_light([3, 3, 3], [1, 1, 1], intensity=500)
c.render_image('/tmp/render.png', samples=64)
